title: Southern Exposure Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Southern Exposure offers its guests spectacular views of the sugar-white sand beach of Seaside and emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico. The first floor of this beautiful beachfront home has a master suite with a king bed, a newly updated, luxurious private bath, and a private furnished deck.
description_expanded: 2368 EAST COUNTY HIGHWAY 30-A - BEACHFRONT IN SEASIDEBeachfront Luxury in Seaside, FloridaSouthern Exposure is a rare, true Gulf-front vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, perfectly situated on two private beachfront lots. This exceptional home offers a peaceful, private retreat with unobstructed views of the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico—an ideal setting for guests seeking relaxation, privacy, and the quintessential Seaside lifestyle.Private Arrival & Outdoor Living SpacesUpon arrival, guests enjoy off-street parking in a private driveway for two vehicles, a valuable amenity in Seaside. As you approach the home, you’re welcomed by a beautifully landscaped outdoor living area set on a private beachfront lot. With Adirondack seating for four surrounded by lush greenery, this garden-like space creates a picture-perfect “Welcome to Seaside” moment and a serene place to unwind.Southern Exposure features multiple porches and outdoor areas, including outdoor dining spaces and beachfront chaise loungers, offering endless opportunities to soak in Gulf breezes and breathtaking coastal views.First-Floor Bedrooms & Private RetreatsThe first level of the home hosts three well-appointed bedrooms, each designed for comfort and privacy. The primary king suite features a mounted flat-screen TV and a renovated ensuite bathroom with dual vanities and a spacious glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain shower head.Double doors open to a private porch with Adirondack seating for two, offering gentle Gulf views through the dunes—an ideal spot for morning coffee accompanied by the sound of rolling waves.The second king bedroom includes a mounted flat-screen TV, a generous closet, and access to an adjacent full bathroom with a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower. The queen bedroom offers its own mounted TV, large closet, and newly added ensuite bathroom with a glass walk-in shower. This room also opens to a small open-air deck with outdoor seating and additional Adirondack chairs nearby.Second-Floor Living, Dining & Gulf ViewsThe second story showcases an open-concept living space designed to highlight sweeping Gulf views. The recently renovated kitchen features stainless-steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator, and a quartz center island with bar seating for three—perfect for entertaining after a day at the beach.Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area comfortably seats four and opens onto a spacious wrap-around porch, one of the home’s standout features. This incredible outdoor space offers alfresco dining for five, two chaise loungers, and panoramic Gulf views—ideal for sunset dinners and star-filled evenings.Beachfront Living Room & Iconic ViewsInside, the Gulf-front living room provides ample seating with two sofas and club chairs, all oriented toward the water. A mounted flat-screen TV is available, though the stunning beachfront views often steal the spotlight. A convenient half bath is also located on this level.From the private beachfront balcony, guests can enjoy Fourth of July and New Year’s Eve fireworks, sunsets over the Gulf, and the soothing rhythm of the waves.A Prime Seaside Gulf-Front EscapeWith its multiple outdoor living spaces, direct beachfront setting, and unmatched Gulf views, Southern Exposure offers one of the most desirable locations in Seaside, Florida. This extraordinary home delivers the ultimate luxury beach vacation experience—where privacy, comfort, and unforgettable coastal scenery come together.* 5NT minimum Spring, Spring Break, & Summer; 3NT minimum Fall & Holiday; 2NT minimum Winter. Must be 25 years old to rent and check in.FEATURES1,642 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah PavilionOne-minute walk, 102 feet from beach access, offering the largest stretch of private beaches on 30APrivate off-street driveway parking for two vehiclesSeven outdoor living areas for lounging, dining, and entertainingTrue beachfront location on two beachside lotsOutdoor shower and charcoal grillFreestanding ice makerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo petsSTR23-001867
